content.text:
**Finding submitted: compliant (no redline).**

The termination bargain meets the preferred T4C position on all four elements:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Customer convenience right over Agreement or Order Form | §9.4 — "terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause" |
| ≤30 days' written notice | §29.4 — thirty days (reached via the §9.4 cross-reference) |
| Pro-rata refund of prepaid fees | §9.4 and §10.2 — refund of prepaid Fees for the period after termination |
| No Vendor convenience right in a committed term | §9 gives Vendor cause-based rights only (9.1/9.2); §13.1 and §24.4 close off suspension and change-of-control exits |

No early-termination fee, penalty or Implementation Fee acceleration exists, so the fallback fee cap is unnecessary. The only residual point — the narrow §1.5 definition of "Fees" as the Implementation Fee, which thins the refund's reach over prepaid subscription charges — is recorded in the rationale for the fees-definition rule rather than double-flagged here, since the fallback for this rule carries no refund element.
